content: Kadiloka bitagoulus Yowbad. Anilivan nises waseg bitasiws dakabyeiwas waseg. Awoum biyamkwaneimiy mwasanin yakamiy.
Anilivan bwanabwein bo isekeids ma̱wana tasiyas. Tasiyas bo ikatiliganes, tage anilivan nag ilabes, peinan nag isimounids waseg.
Ya̱kids gog nitasimounids waseg Yowbad bo bitasiws idakabyeiwas waseg. Tasiyas nag. Anilivan silma̱nin tasiyas kweiboug mamagina:

content.text: “Kapasal nuwag, atabudabod, alana, ‘Tasiyas nag beisiws sikabyeiwas waseg, nag.’”

content: Kweiboug Yowbad ibun ven babaw ikous, mo iyakous nawotet towen. E, liva̱nen nises mamagina:

content.text: “Yam kweinim katanok, Yowbad nawotet bo ikous, kwayuwein yam mo iyeiwas.”

content: Gamag mwasanin beisiws waseg, tasiyas nag. Peinan nikatiliganes anilivan bwanabwein, tage nag isimounids.
E, kweiboug Yowbad nikatigik kweitan yam. Bweilim babaw wankuyeim mo ikatipel ansinap isek Deibid, ilivan ma̱wan:
Kukin Yosuw bisekes sikabyeiwas, wankuyeim Yowbad nag bikatigik kweitan yam. Tage Yosuw nag isekes, nag.
E, dakabyeiwas igaw nises waseg Yowbad, mamagina Sabat, inagamag igaw mo beisiws waseg.
Kukin bitasiws mo bitayeiwas dawotets waseg, ma̱wan Yowbad kweiboug niyeiwas inawotet waseg.
Kadiloka bitatoukums va̱gan bitasiws waseg. Awoum teitan bisiplev aygan mo bikalouw ma̱wana tasiyas kweiboug.

E, Yowbad Tamwamov anilivan tawtoun, singay kakat. Tage seis babeit; Yowbad anilivan kakat, peinan ibas wanuwads, ita̱vid adtuvas waseg, kululuwad son mwamovad bein palatan, kaleivid son tatuwad bein palatan, o ikakina dakanuways, aveiyag sivinads.
Nag kadilok aveiyag bitasowm wamatan. Adsinaps babaw bo ikinbunik, datakaleiwags towen.
Datoveks mamagina lun tanuwagan, Yowbad Natun, Yeisuw, bo nein walba̱lab peinads, kadiloka bitatoukums datapwa̱louls waseg, silma̱nin mtowen.

Tanuwgwes lun mwasanin nag inok nuwes ya̱kids adsinaps igwey. Tage Yeisuw ikakin a̱bads, ikakin-vak adsinaps ven watinow. Kweiboug ven watinow, Seitan bo iyakwen Yeisuw nakabiyokon babaw waseg, ma̱wan iyakwaneids ya̱kids. Seitan iyyokon bo nag. Nag ivag ansinap kalbaleb.
Mapuna takapwapouts bitanekes datakaleiwags Yeisuw mo bisiwyoubuds. E, avei-tut a̱bads bigeg mo binok nuwan ya̱kids, va̱gan bilabeids.
